verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML/compliance screening platform used during customer onboarding, so onboarding-funnel analytics is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence shows no dashboard or reporting for pass rates, drop-off points, or completion time by country or document type. Case filtering and date-ranged data exports (e.g. CUSTOMER_SCREENING) are only building blocks a user could analyze externally, which earn no credit toward this story.
